description:
About the role

Our ingestion API buckles under load and our Postgres queries time out during peak hours. We need someone to profile the FastAPI service, fix the async SQLAlchemy session handling and add proper migrations.

  • Python 3.12, FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy
  • PostgreSQL tuning and schema redesign
  • Docker-based deploys on Linux

Fully remote, part-time contract welcome.
We need a designer to build three WordPress themes with Elementor and hand-crafted visual identity work. Portfolio of graphic design required.

Our legacy ASP.NET Core Web API needs an EF Core upgrade to .NET 8 and a rewrite of the reporting endpoints against SQL Server. Real-time dashboard over WebSockets is a plus.

Remote, contract, flexible hours.
Full-time on-site role in Munich. German language required. Kubernetes fleet ownership.
